Hedge Fund Tycoon Relocates Tax Residency from UK to Greece

Hedge fund tycoon Chris Rokos, identified as the third-largest UK taxpayer, has moved his tax residency from Britain to Greece. Athens has actively persuaded funds, including Rokos', to relocate by offering tax breaks. The Greek government has held discussions with multiple hedge funds, aiming to attract them with these incentives.
